category_title: Highly gifted female prioritizing social survival and employment over academic performance
scenario_title: High verbal engagement with complete avoidance of written assignments
minimal_context: Mariah is in her senior English class working on a written analysis assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Mariah, it is time to work on the written essay for senior English. Please start writing your analysis of the text.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The text is actually fascinating! The author's use of symbolism really shows the protagonist's isolation. I was just explaining to the group over there how the recurring motif of the ocean represents his feeling of drowning in responsibilities.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is a good thought. Go ahead and put those ideas on your paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Yeah, I'll get to it. But honestly, discussing it is so much better. Hey guys, don't you agree the protagonist is just misunderstood? It's way more interesting to talk about it together.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We have been on this unit for weeks now, and today is the last day I can accept work. You need to submit your written assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pulls a wrinkled and stained paper from her bag) Fine, here. I wrote down a few sentences about it. That should be enough for a D so I can pass, right? I have a full-time shift right after this.

task.content: Attending class and submitting written assignments for senior English

context.environment: The classroom became her social haven
context.social_setting: attempting to be the social center of her universe

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Requirement to produce written work over a seven to eight week period
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: turn in no work for seven to eight weeks, and then turn in just enough to pass with a D on the very last day that work was accepted. In reading her cursory sentences on wrinkled and stained paper, my heart sank
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: thought with deep levels of reflection and cognition

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: attend sporadically, engage highly through verbal interaction when present... gave me no product other than her participation
behavior_patterns.internal_state: engaging, articulate, and thought with deep levels of reflection and cognition
